up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity records that have a pChEMBL value for the human single‑protein target CHEMBL5212 (Membrane‑associated guanylate kinase, WW and PDZ domain‑containing protein 3). Include assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, activity standard type, and pChEMBL value. Apply only standard relation '=', non‑null pChEMBL values, and filter target to chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5212'. Return results ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID, without any additional limits or filters.
sql:
WITH IC50_HUMAN AS (
  SELECT 
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.value,
    a.units,
    a.molregno,
    a.assay_id,
    a.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.record_id,
    a.toin,
    a.bao_endpoint,
    a.uo_units,
    a.qudt_units,
    a.tid,
    a.relationship,
    a.type AS activity_type,
    a.structure_id,
    a.activity_id
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5212'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value,
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id
FROM IC50_HUMAN act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
